name: Snowman
about: A big snowman with a red scarf, an orange nose and a black hat.

layers.name: Bottom
layers.tip: Snow blocks in this round shape. Dig snow with a shovel to get snowballs: 4 snowballs make a snow block.

layers.name: Middle and arms
layers.tip: Another square, with a black wool button at the front and a fence on each side for arms.

layers.name: Nose
layers.tip: Snow again, with orange wool sticking out at the front for the nose.

layers.name: Eyes
layers.tip: Snow, with two black wool eyes at the front.

layers.name: Top of the hat
layers.tip: One more black wool in the middle. Want a snowman that moves? Stack two snow blocks with a carved pumpkin on top to make a snow golem.
